\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-22},
  title = {Listings registered after the reference date are dropped},
  note = {\textbf{Absorbs EDN-72} (2026-10-05): the mileage range is a tolerant check, not a filter.},
  date = {2026-09-29},
  milestone = {M3: Quality Assurance},
  topic = {Data Validation and Preprocessing},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {Preprocessing drops every listing whose \texttt{registration\_\allowbreak{}date} lies after the age reference date, which is the snapshot date in training and the request date in serving.
The Great Expectations suites assert the rule hard on the cleaned frame and with a tolerance on the raw frame.
The mileage range of FR-03, 0 to 1,000,000 km, is only a tolerant check on both frames, and the three listings above it stay.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Clamp the age at zero: invents a registration date, and a clamped zero looks like a new car, the group EDN-04 scopes out.
\item Keep negative ages: the API would have to accept them too.
\item Drop the three high-mileage rows as well: changes the training rows and every published count, and moves no gate verdict.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} 164 raw listings carry such a date, and 27 of them reach this rule after scoping.
Dropping them makes a non-negative age an invariant that the pipeline, the tests and the API rely on.
The tolerance on the raw frame keeps a later scrape with many such rows visible as a failed rule.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI profiled the affected rows, laid out the options and recommended dropping them.
For the mileage range it ran the suites on the real snapshot, measured the effect of dropping the three rows with the real stages and recommended the tolerant check.
Lukas accepted both.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code sessions of 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-05 on issue \#25; Lukas chose ``drop them'' and ``keep the tolerant check''.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/reports/analysis/preprocess_funnel_results.txt}{\texttt{preprocess\_\allowbreak{}funnel\_\allowbreak{}results.\allowbreak{}txt}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/reports/analysis/mileage_scope_results.txt}{\texttt{mileage\_\allowbreak{}scope\_\allowbreak{}results.\allowbreak{}txt}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/25}{issue \#25}.},
